technologyBaseline.deployment: cloud, private cloud, hybrid, on-premises, air-gapped and sovereign

invariants: Enterprise Model is the contextual source of truth
AI runtime is not policy authority
No direct AI to production path
Retrieval is authorized before access and re-authorized before AI context
OPA policies are versioned, signed, verified, auditable and environment-aware
Agent state is governed enterprise data
Evidence is append-only, tamper-evident, ordered, traceable and access-controlled
Air-gapped operation has no mandatory external API, AI, SaaS or control-plane dependency
No numerical SLO before workload benchmarking

flows.retrievalAuthorization: Identity -> Purpose -> Policy -> Authorized Scope -> Retrieval -> Fusion -> Authorization Re-check -> AI Context
flows.agenticGovernance: Enterprise Workflow -> Deterministic Step/Approval/AI Step -> Agent Runtime -> Tool Gateway -> Identity -> OPA -> Action -> Evidence
flows.softwareFactory: Intent -> Enterprise Context -> Existing Architecture -> Approved Packages -> AI Planning -> Code Generation -> Static Validation -> Security Validation -> Sandbox -> Tests -> Human Review -> Git -> CI/CD -> Artifact -> Deployment -> Registration -> Observability -> Evidence
flows.observability: Applications -> OpenTelemetry SDK -> Collector Agent -> Trace-aware Routing -> Collector Gateway -> Processing -> Logs/Metrics/Traces -> Storage -> Enterprise Model
flows.evidence: Request -> Context -> Knowledge -> Decision -> Policy -> Approval -> Action -> Result -> Telemetry -> Evidence

changeControl: Change Request -> Impact Analysis -> Architectural Review -> Decision -> Master Specification Update -> Approval
